/--
`Classical.em` variant where disjuncts are marked with `alreadyNorm` gadget.
See comment at `alreadyNorm`
-/
theorem em (p : Prop) : alreadyNorm p ∨ alreadyNorm (¬ p) :=
  Classical.em p
